line: Nothing is more dangerous
than a man who has started to enjoy his pain.
There's a rare type of person
that has played the game long enough
that they learn to love the ups and the downs.
They embrace things when they're tough,
and they actually get a weird,
almost masochistic enjoyment of it.
I call these people bulldozers
because they don't care what obstacles are in front of them,
they just go right through it all
and there's nothing you can do that makes them quit
because they love the ups and downs of the game.
This is actually the concept behind my app, My Future Self,
where you just put in the type of person that you want to be
and it tells you the {day-to-day|day to day} habits that you need to do.
Now all that's left on you
is to embrace the painful parts of life
and actually use that as fuel
to keep going.
